capture_steps: Set macOS output volume to 20 with osascript before playback.
Build and launch the packaged app with ./scripts/build_app_bundle.sh; do not use the bare swift-build executable for capture.
Use Mic+Speaker mode so Core Audio Tap records remote/system audio and AVAudioEngine records local/microphone audio.
Disable LLM by leaving endpointUrl/modelName empty or setting summary and format intervals to 0.
Record aligned remote.wav and local.wav with a shared start timestamp and capture_start_offset_sec.
Write per-lane reference JSONL files with speaker, text, start, and end fields.
If a headed browser is used for validation, close the page/browser before finishing and record cleanup in capture_notes.md.

cases.notes: Captured from signed packaged-app Mic+Speaker mode by playing data/benchmark_diarization_1min/samples/lex_keyu_jin/audio.wav at macOS output volume 20. remote.wav is the Core Audio Tap/system-audio lane; local.wav is the MacBook Pro Microphone room-capture lane. Both lanes contain the same two reference speakers because this fixture is a speaker-playback leakage/source-separation case.
